subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Control UI resolver fix, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open linked cross-repository PR already has closing syntax for this issue and is not directly ready because it is stale, uneditable by maintainers, and targets old UI paths.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it onto current paths, add current proof, and resolve stale check state.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Leave the issue open but ask for a new current-main UI-only PR if adopting the cross-repository branch is not worth the overhead.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it onto current paths, add current proof, and resolve stale check state.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata and Control UI path history represented in the likely-owner evidence.
